output.title: Service account annotation template fix: values not shown
output.content: The change fixes the Helm chart's service account template so boolean values in annotations are handled. The environment installs cert-manager via Helm (flux-helmrelease, argocd-application, helmfile), so the chart template is in play. However, the 9 values keys shown (e.g. global.leaderElection.namespace, replicaCount, webhook.timeoutSeconds) include no serviceAccount annotation key. The values dimension is only "partial", so unseen keys such as service account annotations can't be ruled in or out. Check the full values for any serviceAccount annotations set to boolean values.
